correctness.rationale: The increasing diffeomorphism z=bx−1/x yields z′=F(z)−u with exact F′ sign controlled by max y²(1−2y)=1/27. Scalar ODE order comparison of cumulative controls and adjacent swaps proves the arbitrary-duration ordering, including the sharp equality case. A reconstructed two-flow second-order expansion gives the opposite local signs for B>27 and a rational suppressive witness with 10/441 coefficient. Exact and finite numerical checks ran from the packaged standalone script; finite checks are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: Gives an exact and sharp dimensionless ecological scheduling threshold in carrying capacity divided by Type-III half-saturation, and a strict all-duration exchange law for any finite set of prescribed pressures. The two opposite treatment responses on an open density interval even when both pressures suppress prey provide a substantive mechanistic boundary. No claim of field-realistic biological benefit is made.
